easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Repeat.
